A finding applies first to its sampled food, place and period. Under the declared matched-comparison method, cooked white-rice Cd rises from 4.3 to 5.0 µg/kg and cooked brown-rice Cd from 5.5 to 9.8 µg/kg across five shared winter-region groups in FY2018 versus FY2020 (six versus five composites). These calculated medians describe those matched collections; they do not identify a global cadmium trend.

answers.answer: Nonflooded versus flooded irrigation raised mean polished-grain cadmium from 4.7 to 74 µg/kg in Year 1 and 4.6 to 120 µg/kg in Year 2. These conversions use published mg/kg means; source tables report standard deviations with three mesocosms per arm. The linked arsenic outcomes decreased. The contrasts apply to one site, cultivar and soil; repeated seasons are not independent farms.
